title: A3 split view: assert undo after close and left-Writer DOM identity directly
description: From the T136 review: the DoD says opening OR closing a split keeps the left pane's undo history and scroll position. Add direct Playwright assertions in tests/split-view.spec.ts: (1) type in the left pane, open split, close split, Cmd+Z undoes the typed text; (2) tag the left Writer's editor DOM node (e.g. a data attribute set via evaluate) before opening/closing the split and assert the same node persists after open and after close (no remount); (3) scroll position preserved on close. Show each failing on a scratch pre-A3 build (ui3-a3/scratch from f401 may be reused), passing on the live tree; also take and view light+dark screenshots of the split in continuous and page view. Test-only unless a real bug appears (then report to agent-3663 before touching src).

review.note: Approved. New cases tests/split-view.spec.ts 644-740: tag .split-panes, left pane and left .ProseMirror before open; tags must survive open AND close (a remount drops them); then Cmd+Z empties text after the round trip; scroll within 2 px on open and close. Non-vacuous: pre-A3 scratch dist ff-run.log 2 failed (tag mismatch on open; scroll off 1430 px). Live 16/16 (live-run.log 06:32:33, after spec 06:27:52). tsc exit 0 rerun. 4 screenshots viewed light/dark continuous/page: fine. Caveat: on pre-A3 the open-side check fails first, so close-side and undo asserts were not separately seen red.
